name: Red Fort
scope: Delhi’s standing Red Fort exterior and principal Mughal monuments: the red sandstone wall circuit and barbicans, Lahori and Delhi Gates, covered bazaar, drum house and audience hall, white marble eastern palace pavilions, the Pearl Mosque and Shahi Burj.
era: Standing Red Fort exterior and selected major historic monuments.

originalReview.notes: The University of California Libraries copy and title page establish the exact eighth edition, 1911. The native scan matches the published Qualla map with grayscale correlation 0.999849. The plan describes earlier conditions and is used only where the mapped historic fabric still survives.

Exact public-domain Rijksmuseum albumen print of the Lahori Gate by Samuel Bourne, c.1862–70. Read the layered barbican, battered base, alternating pointed parapet blocks, central gateway, chhatris and half-octagonal gate towers.

review.notes: Started from published Qualla images. The exact 1911 plan was matched to the archive scan and edition. Supplemented it with the public-domain Rijksmuseum print of the same standing gate. Unverified reproductions, attribution-required views and photographs of other locations were excluded.
